ORDER BY aps.id DESC

SELECT aps.id, aps.author_id AS authorId, au.nickname AS nickname, aps.name, aps.price, IFNULL(pi.privilege_num, 0) AS privilegeNum, aps.is_buy AS isBuy, aps.create_time AS createTime, 0 AS pvNum, 0 AS pvUserNum, 0 AS buyCount, 0 AS income, 0 AS fastBuy, aps.tags FROM author_privilege_set aps LEFT JOIN author_user au ON au.id = aps.author_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT privilege_id, COUNT(1) AS privilege_num FROM author_privilege_item WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY privilege_id ) pi ON pi.privilege_id = aps.id WHERE aps.deleted = 0 AND aps.author_id = #{reqVO.authorId} AND aps.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND aps.parent_id > 0 ORDER BY aps.id DESC

SELECT aps.id, aps.author_id AS authorId, aps.type, aps.days, aps.price, aps.parent_id AS parentId, aps.is_discount AS isDiscount, aps.is_buy AS isBuy, aps.buy_num AS buyNum, aps.date, aps.num, aps.article_price AS articlePrice, aps.name, aps.content, aps.deleted, aps.tags FROM ( SELECT privilege_id FROM privilege_push_config WHERE consume_status IN (0, 1, 2) AND push_time BETWEEN CONCAT(#{time}, ':00') AND CONCAT(#{time}, ':59') GROUP BY privilege_id ) apc JOIN author_privilege_set aps ON aps.id = apc.privilege_id WHERE aps.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM author_privilege_item WHERE privilege_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

AND FIND_IN_SET(#{reqVO.tag}, aps.tags)
